self_summary: The runnable SDK shelf: one page per capability, every fence pinned by a test. Connections, credentials, data sources, datasets, activity, agents on email, chat and help-desk channels, message threads, LLM endpoints, processes, workflows, compute ops, wizards, decisions, RAG, project dependencies and the one call-return contract.

files.name: README.md
files.title: Snippets — the dev onboarding shelf
